messages:
lauren: Heads-up: Hosted API streaming + tool-calling v3 is GA and is rolling out starting now across regions. Major wins: more robust streaming frames (checksum + chunk ids), clearer tool-call argument errors, and improved backpressure signals for SDKs. Docs + migration guide: https://docs.redwood.ai/hosted/toolcall-v3

mike: Awesome. Will we proxy v2 endpoints? Any forced client work?

lauren: We'll run v2 in parallel for 30 days and return a Deprecation header on v2 requests. No auth changes. We will auto-redirect traffic from /v2/toolcall -> /v3 for non-custom clients after 14 days; recommend teams upgrade sooner.

anika: QA note: small KV-cache race on very long contexts was found earlier, patch went to canary and is included in the GA build. Watch the dashboard for cache-miss spike.

ops-bot: ops-bot: deploy started for hosted-toolcall-service ap-southeast-1 - build=2026.04.01-900, canary=true

mike: For webhook consumers: payload shape for streamed frames changed (we now emit `chunk_id`, `text`, `complete` and optional `tool_meta`). SDKs will continue to return the legacy shape when api_version=="v2" but raw consumers must update. Migration examples in docs.

lauren: We've bumped temporary burst quotas for paid customers to smooth migrations. Support will route any throttle reports to #support.

marketing-bot: marketing-bot: scheduled blog post for tomorrow 10:00 PDT; social assets queued. Please DM an executive quote (1-2 sentences) to #marketing-distro.

anika: Observability: new console panels live -> /ops/dashboards/toolcall-v3 (latency, frame-fail-rate, webhook-4xx). Alerts: frame checksum failures and detokenization mismatches.

mike: Also note: streaming detokenization is now deterministic by default which should reduce jittered tool outputs across retries. Regression tests added.

lauren: Customer comms: emailing tenants with >5k req/day. High-touch account owners, add any special notes before EOD so we include them. If you see customer-impacting issues, escalate to @eng-oncall immediately. Thanks everyone :rocket:
